description: Free annual academic access to IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, PyCharm Professional, WebStorm, CLion, DataGrip, and all JetBrains desktop IDEs.

requirements.payment_method_notes: Zero payment details needed; verify via university email, ISIC card, or GitHub Student Pack.

validity.auto_renewal: Does not auto-charge; manual re-verification required annually. Graduation discount (40% off) is separate from free access.

restrictions: Strictly limited to non-commercial educational learning and academic coursework.
Post-graduation transition offers a paid discount (not free).

eligibility.conditions: Requires Student ID / .edu email: verify with university .edu email, ISIC/ITIC card, GitHub Student Developer Pack, or official enrollment document.

claims.quote: Free educational licenses for all JetBrains IDEs are available to verified students and teachers for non-commercial use.
